subject.title: feat: surface skill opportunities and capture Workboard follow-up

question: Should reusable-workflow opportunities have a generic core extension point that Workboard may consume, or should Workboard-specific automatic card capture be excluded from the core Skill Workshop flow?
rationale: The implementation chooses a permanent ownership and user-experience policy for an optional plugin; that cannot safely be settled by a mechanical code repair alone.

options.title: Use a generic plugin seam
options.body: Expose a plugin-neutral opportunity event or injected handler and move Workboard card creation and marker policy into the Workboard plugin.

options.title: Accept direct core coupling
options.body: Deliberately retain `workboard_create`-specific core prompt behavior and document Workboard as a required bundled product dependency.

recommendation.title: Use a generic plugin seam
recommendation.body: Expose a plugin-neutral opportunity event or injected handler and move Workboard card creation and marker policy into the Workboard plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed cross-boundary design and can clarify its intended ownership while a history-backed core owner is identified.
